remarks: Experience life at elegant Greenwich Towers. Imagine owning a spacious, bright, 2-bedroom / 2.5 bath apartment in a premier in-town Greenwich location! Welcome to this splendid duplex with a wealth of newly added special features that includes rare ownership of TWO Deeded Garage Parking Spaces. It boasts a gracious, sun-filled, open floor plan with abundant windows that fill the space with sunlight and views of LI Sound & Manhattan's skyline. Owners have thoughtfully renovated and upgraded the home over the last 3-years by refinishing vintage floors, refurbishing and painting walls and deep windowsills, adding custom window treatments throughout, adding custom staircase rug / carpet up the stairs to the dramatic upper hallway, and by creating an unrivaled designer EIK! The 2025 custom EIK features natural quartzite counters & backsplash, beautiful Miralis cabinetry, abundant storage & workspace, SubZero, Wolf gas range w/oven + Wolf wall oven & microwave, wine chiller & integrated laundry center. Upstairs, the stunning Primary BR w/fireplace and sitting area plus 2nd BR w/lovely en suite both have closets with outfitted interiors. New heating units, new air conditioning and a 2Easy high tech system on each level add to the splendor - while feature sheet tells all! Residents enjoy a roof-top deck & basement storage unit that add to ease of condominium living. Walk to Metro North & enjoy Greenwich beaches, town shopping, dining and parks. Your ideal life awaits!
